skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understanding basic concepts of electric and magnetic fields.
Analyzing properties and characteristics of electric and magnetic fields.
Understanding and applying Maxwell's equations to electromagnetic phenomena.
Understanding electrical and magnetic properties of materials.
Analyzing wave propagation in electromagnetic fields.
Developing problem-solving skills through practical exercises and group projects.
Enhancing teamwork and collaboration skills through group activities.
Improving critical thinking abilities by analyzing complex physical phenomena.
